    def upload_file(self, file_path):
        """Upload a file in the open chat by clicking the upload icon (which opens the

        Validates a NEW image bubble appears (not a stale one) by comparing counts.
        """
        # Count existing uploaded-image bubbles before uploading
        before_count = self.page.locator(self.UPLOADED_IMAGE_ALL).count()
        print(f"[upload_file] images before: {before_count}")

        with self.page.expect_file_chooser() as fc_info:
            self.page.locator(self.FILE_UPLOAD_ICON).click()
        fc_info.value.set_files(file_path)
    
        # Let the app read the file and render its preview/attachment chip
        self.page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    
        # Click Send and wait for the coach_communications POST that carries the file
        send_btn = self.page.locator(self.UPLOAD_SEND_BUTTON)
        expect(send_btn).to_be_enabled()

            with self.page.expect_response(
                lambda r: "coach_communications" in r.url and r.request.method == "POST" and r.status < 400,
                timeout=2000,
            ) as resp_info:
                send_btn.click()
            resp = resp_info.value
            print(f"✓ Upload POST response: {resp.status} {resp.url}")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[upload_file] no upload POST captured ({e})")
    
        self.page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
        # Validate a NEW uploaded image appeared in the conversation
